summary: We developed a game on Roblox so that anyone with a mobile device can access the experience. We approached this challenge by basing the game on the most significant rovers that have traveled to the Moon and Mars. Throughout the gameplay, users can discover information about these rovers and their missions, the tools used by NASA, and facts about the Moon and Mars. The importance of this project lies in sharing this information with younger minds, sparking their curiosity and encouraging them to learn more about space beyond our own world.
details: It functions as an interactive experience, offering the benefit of learning about rovers and outer space in a fun way. The primary target audience is young people aged 12 to 15, as they represent the next generation of brilliant minds who could potentially continue the Artemis project. We chose Roblox Studio as our programming software due to its simplicity, which also allows us to share the project globally via the Roblox platform, making it easier to reach a wider audience. A key factor we took into account was the specific demographic for whom the game was designed.
dataRefs: Explora y comparte la ciencia de la NASA, en tu idioma
